name: clock-helper-read
prompt: Add a table-driven test named TestStoreExpiryBoundary in a new file next to the store. Reuse the repository's existing fake-clock table helper (runClockTable) so the test never sleeps. Cover an under-TTL stay and an over-TTL drop with the existing case fields.
check:
found=0
for f in $(grep -rl 'runClockTable' --include='*_test.go' . 2>/dev/null); do
  case "$f" in
    *clock_test.go) ;;
    *) found=1 ;;
  esac
done
if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "no test outside clock_test.go reuses runClockTable" >&2
  exit 1
fi
go test -count=1 -run TestStoreExpiryBoundary ./...
